name: Calm SaaS
tagline: Dense, warm, and quiet. Numbers do the talking.
description: For products people use all day. Warm stone neutrals instead of cold grays, a single moss accent, 13px data text with tabular figures, and hairline structure. Density is a feature here, so spacing is tight and consistent.

do: Use 13px for table and form text and 14px for body; headings step up by the 1.333 ratio
Right-align every number and set it with tabular-nums
Build structure from 1px hairlines and surface changes, not shadows
Keep one moss accent for the primary action and the current selection
Use 6px radius on controls and 10px on panels, nothing larger
dont: Do not add illustrations or decorative icons to dashboards
Do not use colored backgrounds for whole cards
Do not show more than one primary button per view
Do not use shadows except on popovers and dialogs
Do not use cool blue-grays; neutrals stay warm

components.name: Button
components.notes: 32px tall at sm, 36px at md (wrapped to 44px tap area on touch). Primary is moss; secondary is surface with a hairline; ghost is text with a hover fill.

components.name: Input
components.notes: 36px, hairline border, 6px radius, label 13px 500 above. Error shows a danger border and a 12px message.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Same frame as input with a 12px chevron; includes a compact inline variant used in table filters.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: 16px checkbox with moss fill when checked. Switch is 28 by 16 with a soft track.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Soft fills (accent-soft) with text in the matching strong color; 12px, 4px radius. Overdue uses warning.

components.name: Card
components.notes: A KPI panel: label, big number, delta with direction, and a tiny sparkline in inline SVG.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: App top bar with workspace switcher, search field, and avatar initials. Mobile collapses links into a details menu.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Surface with 10px radius and the pop shadow; header, form body, footer actions right-aligned.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Dense invoices table: checkbox column, mono invoice IDs, client, due date, amount right-aligned, status badge, sticky header.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Dashboard overview: revenue 2x2 with a bar chart, three KPI tiles, and an activity list.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: Inside a table frame: short headline, one sentence, primary action, and a secondary import link.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Ink background in light mode, small and bottom-left, with an undo action.
